name: share_live_location
description: Text the person a link that shares their phone's live location with the response team until help reaches them. Call it ONLY after you asked "Can I text you a link that shares your phone's live location with the response team? It stays on only until help reaches you." and the person clearly said yes. Never on a no, a maybe, silence, or a yes to something else. Call it at most once per call.

consent_quote.description: The person's own words saying yes, verbatim (e.g. 'Yes, send it').
